name: @splotch/asset-gen
description: AI/sharp asset-generation pipeline for Splotch. NOT a workspace and NOT separately installed — its dependencies (sharp, @google/genai) live in the repo-root package.json, which is also where the single node_modules lives (ADR-0053; ADR-0119 keeps it flat for cap sync). Run these via the repo-root `npm run gen:*` / `check:*` / `update:*` scripts, or the aliases below from inside this folder; either way binaries resolve from the hoisted root node_modules. Do not install here.
